annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
key_provisions_or_claims: Advanced robotics and AI systems create OSH opportunities, such as removing workers from high-risk environments, and risks that are physical, psychosocial and organisational.
Seminar held in Brussels on 15 March 2023 with break-out sessions on regulation, inspections and OSH management.
Presents EU-OSHA desk and field research and use cases of task automation across Europe.
Aims to set priorities for EU policymaking and recommendations for developing such systems.
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA event page for a 15 March 2023 Brussels seminar on occupational safety and health implications of advanced robotics, cobots and AI-based task automation. It outlines opportunities and physical, psychosocial and organisational risks, and plans break-out sessions on regulation, inspection and OSH management to inform EU policy priorities.
annotation.title_clean: Advanced robotics and AI-based systems for automation of tasks
